question: Which ministry of Government of India has published Goods and Service Tax (GST) Act, 2017 ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Law and Justice.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Goods and Services Tax (GST) is an indirect tax used in India on the manufacture, sale, and consumption of goods and services in India.
 
• The Goods and Service Tax (GST) Act, 2017 was published by the **Ministry of Law and Justice.**__
